rules.name: Support Team
rules.description: A Scorpio Team consists of two Warriors and a Scorpio. The unit may only perform a Move or Shoot action if it first performs a Special action. A Shoot action may only be performed if at least one Warrior is in contact with the Scorpio.

rules.name: Scorpio
rules.description:
When performing a Shoot action, a Scorpio has the following profile: Range: 40", Special Rules: Lethal 3, Smasher.
A Scorpio can remove more than one model with a single hit (due to its Lethal rule) in the same way as a Hero.
